title: A queued job placed as shared is counted at its share (0.65, D-066) of its cost on one worker with no partner check; a stale one holds cores until it expires
notes: A newcomer is refused for cores a job nobody is making holds, until it expires. Promote on: a dogfood refusal whose decision line shows cores held by a queued job no worker claimed. Kin to BL-124; triage together.
